description: This file defines API routes for managing customer service requests, including creating, retrieving, updating status, listing with filters, managing attachments, and fetching history. It uses FastAPI and depends on several internal modules for business logic, error handling, security, and storage.

methods.name: RequestService get_service()
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of RequestService, managing in-memory repository.

methods.name: AttachmentStore get_attachment_store()
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of AttachmentStore with filesystem-backed content.
